key_insight: Training language models on structured experimental evidence enabled perovskite-specific reasoning that guided a experimentally validated solar-cell contact design.
engineering_relevance: OpenPerov selected a K-based self-assembled monolayer analogue over the expert-preferred Na analogue, yielding devices with 27.05% efficiency and strong thermal-ageing retention.
method: Reconstruct expert-calibrated evidence records from 4,035 training articles.
Adapt models using links between experimental strategies, controls, observations and mechanisms.
Revise selected responses with retrieved evidence and experimentally test a model-selected contact.
evidence_signal: On the 800-question PSM-Bench, OpenPerov Flash ranked first among 13 closed-book systems; retrieval-assisted Pro increased Scientific Mastery from 87.6 to 89.1.
watch_item: Reported durability reflects 1,000 hours of dark thermal ageing at 85°C, not long-term operation under illumination.
paper_title: Evidence-grounded large language models guide perovskite solar cell design and optimization
